name: Organic Mocha Cold Brew Latte
caffeineNote: Brand states 91–101 mg per 8 oz can, the strongest of the four Groundwork variants
summary: Cocoa stirred into Groundwork's Certified Organic cold brew and built on almond butter, the strongest can in their line at a brand-stated 91–101 mg per 8 oz. It is also the only one of the four that adds sugar — 7 g of date sugar inside 10 g total — alongside monk fruit, at 140 calories and 3 g of protein.
